subject: Temporary SOC 2 access + evidence provenance and credential rotation
messages:
From: James Rolfe <james.rolfe@acme-corp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-04-12 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II access + evidence provenance

Hi Irene,

We are kicking off the procurement review for a new feature integration and need access to your SOC 2 Type II report and a short window in your trust portal to pull supporting evidence. Two auditors from our vendor (Kestrel Audit LLP) will need view + limited download rights for specific artifact bundles.

A couple of specific asks up front:
- Can you confirm whether evidence files include integrity metadata (e.g., SHA256 checksums) or a signed manifest?
- Do you provide a bridge letter for the gap between your last report and the current one (if applicable)?
- We may need a credential rotation mid-window and a short audit log export (CSV) showing download events.

Attaching a list of what our procurement team typically requests. Can we get a one-time SSO link that is timeboxed to 72 hours? Timezone preference: EDT.

Thanks,
James Rolfe
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme-soc2-evidence-request.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: James Rolfe <james.rolfe@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-04-12 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II access + evidence provenance

Hi James — thanks for the clear list. We can support the access and the provenance details you described; below is how we typically handle this to keep everything auditable.

High-level plan we propose:
- Trust portal one-time SSO link: 72-hour window, starts when auditors first authenticate.
- Download rights: scoped to specific evidence bundles only (no whole-bucket downloads).
- Evidence provenance: every bundle includes a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) and a manifest signature produced by our compliance pipeline. We can also provide a separate chain-of-custody CSV showing file name, checksum, created_at, and exported_by.
- Audit logs: we will export a CSV showing download event timestamps, actor email, and IP address for the window.
- Credential rotation: we support a scheduled rotation mid-window. We rotate the ephemeral SSO token and update the active session; the previous token is revoked immediately.

Next steps from us (what I'll do after we confirm auditors):
1) Prepare one-time SSO link and a session rotation plan (I will attach a short CSV with the rotation timestamp and token IDs).
2) Generate signed bridge letter draft (we can sign and return as a PDF) if you confirm the audit period gap.
3) Provide sample manifest and an example chain-of-custody CSV for your auditor review.

Could you confirm the full names and emails for the Kestrel auditors and the preferred 72-hour start window in EDT? We can draft the bridge letter and get it signed once we have those details.

I’m copying Marissa (security ops) and Kimberly (compliance evidence owner) so they can coordinate the portal invite and exports.

Best,
Irene Choi
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: bridge-template.pdf

From: James Rolfe <james.rolfe@acme-corp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance-team@acme-corp.com
Date: 2029-04-13 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II access + evidence provenance

Irene — thanks, that plan looks good. Auditors below:
- Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@kestrel-audit.com>
- Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@kestrel-audit.com>

Preferred window: Start 2029-04-17 13:00 EDT (which should be 2029-04-17 10:00 PDT for your team). We do need the ability to download defined evidence bundles (zip per control family) and we will ask for the chain-of-custody CSV and the audit log export at the end of Day 2.

One additional question: do you record session-level activity for the portal (e.g., screen capture or session video)? Our internal audit policy asks about session recordings. If not, a signed statement of what the audit logs include will suffice.

Also: we anticipate rotating credentials mid-window (after 36 hours) to demonstrate rotation procedure. Please include a short rotation plan and the intended revoke timestamp so we can walk through it during the audit.

James

Date: 2029-04-15 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II access + evidence provenance

Thanks — confirmed for Kestrel auditors and the 2029-04-17 13:00 EDT start. Final notes and artifacts below.

What we will deliver before the start:
- One-time SSO link (starts on first auth): https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/session/one-time/XYZ-72H
- Session rotation plan (rotation at 2029-04-19 01:00 EDT / we will revoke old token and issue new token): see session-rotation-plan.csv attached.
- Evidence bundles: each ZIP includes a signed manifest (SHA256) and a signature file.
- Chain-of-custody CSV and audit log CSV will be exported after Day 2 and delivered as signed artifacts.
- Bridge letter: attached signed PDF (bridge-letter-signed.pdf). This confirms the audit period boundaries and that artifacts represent our control state as of the stated dates.

Session recording: we do not perform screen capture or video recording of auditor sessions. Our audit logs capture authentication, download events, IP, and timestamps. I will include a short signed statement of what the logs include with the exports.

We will:
- Send the SSO link to the two auditors and to you at 2029-04-17 09:45 PDT (15 minutes before the window) so they can authenticate and start at 13:00 EDT.
- Perform rotation at the scheduled time and record the revoke/issue events in the audit log.
- Deprovision access at 2029-04-20 13:00 EDT (end of 72-hour window).

If that schedule works, I will mark the session as ready and attach the session-rotation CSV and signed bridge letter now.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: session-rotation-plan.csv, bridge-letter-signed.pdf
